title: Synthesizing Post-Acetazolamide Cerebral Blood Flow Maps from Baseline MRI in Moyamoya Using 3D Generative AI
abstract: arXiv:2608.14758v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: For patients with Moyamoya disease, impaired cerebrovascular reserve (CVR) is an important hemodynamic criterion for recommending extracranial-to-intracranial bypass surgery. Standard CVR assessment in this cohort uses paired arterial spin labeling (ASL) perfusion MRI acquired before and after acetazolamide (ACZ). When ACZ is contraindicated or avoided, the post-ACZ cerebral blood flow (CBF) map needed for hemodynamic assessment is unavailable. We propose CAE3D, a deterministic 3D conditional autoencoder that synthesizes post-ACZ CBF maps directly from pre-ACZ ASL input. We evaluated CAE3D against ten comparators, including deterministic and diffusion-style 3D baselines, a 2D contextual baseline, and frozen-encoder foundation-model adapters. translated_title: 基于3D生成式AI从烟雾病基线MRI合成乙酰唑胺后脑血流图
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14758v1 公告类型：跨领域 摘要：对于烟雾病患者，脑血管储备（CVR）受损是推荐颅内外搭桥手术的重要血流动力学标准。该队列的标准CVR评估使用乙酰唑胺（ACZ）前后采集的配对动脉自旋标记（ASL）灌注MRI。当ACZ禁忌或避免使用时，血流动力学评估所需的ACZ后脑血流（CBF）图不可用。我们提出CAE3D，一种确定性3D条件自编码器，可直接从ACZ前ASL输入合成ACZ后CBF图。我们将CAE3D与十种比较方法进行了评估，包括确定性和扩散式3D基线、2D上下文基线和冻结编码器基础模型适配器。CAE3D实现了最低的留出集MAE（0.066），SSIM为0.80，PSNR为24.0 dB，且全脑平均偏差接近零。其MAE优势在八个从零训练的基线中，对七个具有统计学显著性。
tldr: 本文提出CAE3D，一种3D条件自编码器，可直接从烟雾病患者的ACZ前ASL MRI合成ACZ后CBF图，在准确性上优于多种基线方法，为无法使用ACZ的患者提供了一种有效的CVR评估替代方案。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CAE3D, a 3D conditional autoencoder that synthesizes post-acetazolamide CBF maps directly from pre-ACZ ASL MRI in Moyamoya patients, achieving superior accuracy over multiple baselines and offering an alternative for CVR assessment when ACZ is contraindicated.
